claim: Vera exposes a normal-user Privacy Flight Recorder: per-turn receipts, sanitized off-device egress events, default-deny connector receipt policy, and weather/location precision. Weather uses coarse coordinates by default for named users, exact coordinates only when selected, and off blocks before a socket. Receipt files do not store prompt text, API keys, query tokens, raw URL paths, message bodies, or connector payloads.
owner: anima/privacy_receipts.py (receipt_history, connector_policy, record_connector_egress, prepare_location_for_egress), anima/context_gather.py (weather precision before Open-Meteo egress), anima/caps.py (location_precision enum), anima/server.py (/privacy shell + /privacy/receipts.json), anima/web/privacy.html (viewer), scripts/certify_privacy_receipt_viewer.py

killer_test.name: privacy_flight_recorder_receipts_connector_policy_and_coarse_location
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store. Seed turn receipts, weather lookups, and a connector event. Prove named users default to coarse weather coordinates; exact requires selecting exact; off blocks weather before urlopen. Prove /privacy and /privacy/receipts.json are wired, the viewer strips query keys and does not store auth secrets, connector events require connector/action/decision/purpose, and raw prompts/API keys/query tokens/raw URL paths/message bodies are absent from receipt files. Real .anima byte-unchanged.
killer_test.prompt: show me what left my Mac

known_gaps: This is a receipt and policy layer for connector egress. Future Gmail/GitHub/etc. connectors must still be individually certified against this policy when they are added.
